text: 52 Alia falls sick. 3.8 1. Do you know the people who help us? 2. Listen, read and enact. Alia is not feeling well. She visits her family doctor with her mother. Mother : Namaste doctor! Alia : Hello, Doctor Didi! Doctor : Hello dear! What’s wrong with you? Alia : I am having fever. I have cough and cold too! Doctor : Come, let me check you. [Doctor checks Alia.] Doctor : Yes, you have fever. Do you have throat pain? Alia : Yes, I do. Doctor : Don’t worry Alia. I will give you medicine. Alia : Thank you, Doctor Didi. Mother : Thanks a lot, doctor.
